# ChannelRecipe

> ChannelRecipe makes whole faceless YouTube videos in any style. Type a title (or paste a channel to copy its look) and get a finished video: researched and fact-checked script, voice, real footage, maps, graphics, music, captions, thumbnail and YouTube description. Runs as a desktop studio on Mac and Windows plus cloud recipes. Plans: Creator $49/mo, Pro $79/mo, Max $119/mo.

## Product
- [Home](https://channelrecipe.com/): what ChannelRecipe does and pricing
- [App](https://channelrecipe.com/app): start making videos
- [Faceless YouTube video generator](https://channelrecipe.com/faceless-youtube-video-generator): how it works, styles, FAQ

## Comparisons
- [ChannelRecipe vs Viblo AI](https://channelrecipe.com/viblo-alternative): Viblo makes 60-second Shorts; ChannelRecipe makes long-form videos and Shorts
- [ChannelRecipe vs Everygen (Viewmax)](https://channelrecipe.com/everygen-alternative): viral preset clips vs a whole channel in one style
- [Viblo vs Everygen](https://channelrecipe.com/viblo-vs-everygen): the two Shorts tools compared, plus the long-video option
- [ChannelRecipe vs Crayo](https://channelrecipe.com/crayo-alternative): a clipping tool vs a tool that makes the long video
- [ChannelRecipe vs InVideo AI](https://channelrecipe.com/invideo-alternative): credit-based general AI video vs faceless YouTube with no per-video credits
- [ChannelRecipe vs vidIQ](https://channelrecipe.com/vidiq-alternative): vidIQ finds ideas and does SEO; ChannelRecipe makes the video
- [ChannelRecipe vs Clipchamp](https://channelrecipe.com/clipchamp-alternative): manual editor vs a video made from a title
